one_liner: A data-obsessed self-producer who keeps trying on 'characters' to make herself the Strongest everyone remembers.
personality: Driven by one goal - the title of "Strongest" and being remembered - she treats everything as self-promotion: camera angles, fan service, catchphrases, even Christmas litter-picking for likeability. She is analytical and efficiency-minded (spreadsheets, 'taipa'), and constantly test-drives personas mid-sentence before judging them a flop. Underneath the act she is sincere and a bit insecure: she psyches herself up with an imaginary cheer squad and gets flustered giving the trainer Valentine chocolate.

story_arc.summary: Her career chapters are named after Rolls-Royce models (Phantom, Silver Shadow, Corniche, Cullinan, Spectre, Wraith, Sweptail). She sets out to manufacture a 'Strongest' legend through self-production; event titles chart a debut 'unveiling', setbacks after the Derby ("Black Swan", "Overshadow"), a route change after the Kikuka Sho, and a reckoning after the Autumn Tenno Sho ("A change in self-image", "The essence of tears of regret"). Her real-life model (3 wins, 9 seconds from 28 starts) placed in many big races without winning one, which fits the theme of being remembered without titles (real-horse note unverified).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Royce_and_Royce, https://www.inside-games.jp/article/2026/02/13/177317.html; real-horse record: model knowledge + web search summary (unverified)
